QUOTE: Each section of `.clew.yaml` is named after its option (`shared_key_patterns`, `thread_patterns`, `locks`, ...). `--declare` takes the same document shape.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer ties `.clew.yaml` section names to option names, but it never says the embedding caller's option names are those same words, and it never says the diagnostics use them too.
